messages.content: What year was the law of universal gravitation published by Isaac Newton?

function.name: publication_year_find
function.description: Fetches the year a particular scientific work was published. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

author.description: Name of the author of the work.

location.description: Place of the publication, if known. Default to 'all'.

message.content:
Newton’s formulation of the **law of universal gravitation** appeared in the *first edition* of his seminal book:

> **Principia Mathematica – Philosophiae Naturalis Principia Mathematica**  
> Author: Sir Isaac Aldous Newton  
> Publication Year: **1687**

This volume introduced the inverse‑square law \(F=\frac{G\,m_1 m_2}{r^2}\) and laid out the mathematical framework that underpins classical mechanics.
message.reasoning:

We can provide answer directly without tool call because it's common knowledge. But we might use tool to confirm. Let's see what tool does: It fetches year a particular scientific work was published given author and title. For Newton's law, maybe the relevant work is Principia Mathematica (Mathematical Principles of Natural Philosophy). That was first edition 1687. So answer likely 1687.

But the prompt says "When did it get published" - could refer to Principia or perhaps his paper on gravity. He wrote "Philosophiae Naturalis Principia Mathematica". First edition 1687. So answer: 1687.

Thus no tool needed. Provide answer with citation referencing Principia. Use markdown.
